import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {PixelWorld,createLevel,PHYSICS} from '../dist/2d/world.js';
const step=(w,n,input={})=>{for(let i=0;i<n;i++)w.step(1/120,input)};
test('both long routes have unique platform ids, safe checkpoints and achievable gaps',()=>{for(const l of [0,1]){const a=createLevel(l);assert.ok(a.length>(l?16000:11000));assert.ok(a.enemies.length>25);assert.equal(new Set(a.platforms.map(p=>p.id)).size,a.platforms.length);for(let i=1;i<a.ground.length;i++){const p=a.ground[i-1],q=a.ground[i];assert.ok(q.x-(p.x+p.w)<PHYSICS.speed*PHYSICS.jump/PHYSICS.gravity*2-4)}for(const c of a.checkpoints)assert.ok(a.ground.some(p=>c.x>=p.x&&c.x+22<p.x+p.w&&c.y===p.y))}});
test('jump buffering, double jump and held jump do not create infinite jumps',()=>{const w=new PixelWorld;w.step(1/120,{jump:true});assert.equal(w.player.jumps,1);step(w,20,{jump:true});assert.equal(w.player.jumps,1);w.step(1/120,{});w.step(1/120,{jump:true});assert.equal(w.player.jumps,0);assert.ok(w.player.vy< -400);w.step(1/120,{});w.step(1/120,{jump:true});assert.equal(w.player.jumps,0);step(w,240,{});assert.equal(w.player.grounded,true);assert.equal(w.player.jumps,2)});
test('dash grants a short invulnerability window and has a cooldown',()=>{const w=new PixelWorld;w.step(1/120,{dash:true,x:1});assert.ok(w.player.vx>700);assert.equal(w.hurt(1,w.player.x+50),false);step(w,50,{});assert.equal(w.player.dash,0);assert.ok(w.player.dashCooldown>0);const hp=w.player.hp;assert.equal(w.hurt(1,w.player.x+50),true);assert.equal(w.player.hp,hp-1)});
test('each slash hits once and a hit freezes simulation briefly',()=>{const w=new PixelWorld,e=w.enemies.find(e=>e.type==='brute');Object.assign(w.player,{x:e.x-48,y:e.home.y-42,grounded:true,on:e.home.id});step(w,10,{attack:true});assert.equal(e.hp,e.maxHp-w.combat.damage[0]);assert.ok(w.hitstop>0);const time=w.time;w.step(1/120,{attack:true});assert.equal(w.time,time);step(w,14,{});assert.equal(e.hp,e.maxHp-w.combat.damage[0])});
test('held attacks cycle all three combo stages and heavy hits knock enemies back',()=>{const w=new PixelWorld;let stages=[];for(let i=0;i<130;i++){w.step(1/120,{attack:true});for(const e of w.drain())if(e.type==='swing')stages.push(e.stage)}assert.deepEqual(stages.slice(0,4),[0,1,2,0]);const e=w.enemies[0];w.player.attackId=100;w.player.face=1;w.hitEnemy(e,2,2);assert.ok(e.vx>=390);assert.ok(e.vy<0)});
test('melee reflects enemy bullets and reflected bullets damage enemies',()=>{const w=new PixelWorld;w.projectiles.push({x:120,y:390,w:12,h:12,vx:-220,vy:0,life:4,owner:'enemy'});step(w,7,{attack:true});assert.equal(w.projectiles[0].owner,'player');assert.ok(w.projectiles[0].vx>0);assert.ok(w.drain().some(e=>e.type==='parry'))});
test('damage invulnerability prevents repeated contact damage and death restores checkpoint',()=>{const w=new PixelWorld;assert.equal(w.hurt(1,200),true);const hp=w.player.hp;assert.equal(w.hurt(1,200),false);assert.equal(w.player.hp,hp);w.checkpoint=2;w.score=250;w.collected.add(1);w.respawn();assert.equal(w.player.hp,6);assert.equal(w.player.x,w.level.checkpoints[2].x);assert.equal(w.score,250);assert.equal(w.collected.size,1)});
test('exit requires defeating the boss and completion emits once',()=>{const w=new PixelWorld,a=w.level.ground.at(-1),boss=w.enemies.find(e=>e.type==='boss');Object.assign(w.player,{x:w.level.length-90,y:a.y-42,vx:0,vy:0,grounded:true,on:a.id});step(w,2);assert.equal(w.complete,false);boss.dead=true;step(w,2);assert.equal(w.complete,true);step(w,10);assert.equal(w.drain().filter(e=>e.type==='complete').length,1)});
